description: This file declares functions and structures related to PRACH (Physical Random Access Channel) configuration validation and pattern fitting, used in 3GPP NR (5G) radio access network implementations.

classes.name: tdd_ul_dl_config_common
classes.description: Forward declaration of TDD UL/DL configuration structure used in pattern fitting and validation functions.

methods.name: prach_config_index_is_valid
methods.description: Checks if a given PRACH configuration index is valid for specified frequency range and duplex mode.

methods.name: zero_correlation_zone_is_valid
methods.description: Validates if a PRACH Zero Correlation Zone is valid for given configuration parameters.

methods.name: prach_fits_in_tdd_pattern
methods.description: Determines if a PRACH configuration index fits within a specified TDD UL/DL pattern.

methods.name: find_valid_prach_config_index
methods.description: Finds a PRACH configuration index that ensures PRACH occurs in a TDD UL slot.

methods.name: nof_ssb_per_ro_and_nof_cb_preambles_per_ssb_is_valid
methods.description: Checks validity of the number of SSB per RACH occasion and contention-based preambles per SSB.

methods.name: prach_root_sequence_index_is_valid
methods.description: Validates if a PRACH Root Sequence Index is valid for a given PRACH format.
